scope.issueTitle: [CKS-06] Qualification profiles and smallest-qualified R/K/P/U router
scope.subject: offline deterministic public-readback and close-readiness harness for a separately authorized external outcome

offlineHarness.credentialRule: The command must run with GH_TOKEN unset and the verifier sends no authorization header.
readbackAssertions: release ID, publication timestamp, URL, tag, title, target, draft, prerelease, and Latest state match the bound governance tuple
tag reference object SHA and type remain exact
public release body includes the bound increment and does not use prohibited Daily identity
asset-name set and sizes are exact with no missing or extra asset
every downloaded asset byte count and SHA-256 match the bound inventory
asset checksum manifest declares the exact bound asset digest and name
raw main public surfaces match the local bounded files
offlineHarness.positiveCompletionRule: An external PUBLIC_READBACK_PASS may be recorded only after separate authorization, completed publication where applicable, anonymous command exitCode=0, and preservation of that command's complete readback result against the authorized release tuple.
offlineHarness.failClosedRule: Absent authorization, absent completed publication evidence, a nonzero command result, any tuple mismatch, any missing or extra asset, a digest mismatch, or a public-surface mismatch yields no public-readback success claim.

closeReadiness.deterministicRule: noReleaseReadinessReceipt.releaseAuthorizationPresent=false AND noReleaseReadinessReceipt.releaseActionsPerformed=false => retain CLOSED_NO_RELEASE and do not run or claim an external public readback for the CKS-06 advisory slice
closeReadiness.eventualAuthorizedOutcomeBoundary: A future release or other external outcome requires its own explicit authorization and then the anonymous public-readback completion rule; this receipt neither supplies nor infers either condition.

verification.requiredEvidenceConclusion: Bounded local governance and CKS-06 evidence support preparing the offline harness only; they do not support an external public-readback success or publication claim.
